title: Investigating persuasive software features for addiction recovery
core_idea: The study aims to understand how persuasive systems design (PSD) features in behavior change support systems (BCSS) influence recovery from digital and alcohol addiction by assessing how specific persuasive software elements interact with well-being, self-efficacy, addiction behavior change, and user engagement. The work follows three stages: foundational design, application development with a pilot, and two experimental studies to test the developed BCSS.
tldr: Research to identify which persuasive software features in BCSS support recovery from digital and alcohol addiction, using a three-stage process of design, pilot, and experimental evaluation.
